identity.description: An attacker uses a suspicious process to load a known PowerShell module, which triggers the Cortex alert for Suspicious process loads a known PowerShell module. This behavior is indicative of potential PowerShell-based attacks.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started with hidden window

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Module Load
biocs.description: A process loads a known PowerShell module in an unusual context
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.psd1'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual PowerShell Module Load
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a non-interactive process loads a PowerShell module
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.psd1'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: PowerShell Module Load Detection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.psd1'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| comp count() by action_file_path
